articles.title: Experts say Israel is still committing genocide after Gaza ceasefire
articles.description: A ceasefire agreement in Gaza has not stopped what a group of independent experts commissioned by the U.N. say is genocide carried out by Israel in the territory, the team said in a new report Monday. They also accused Israeli forces of crimes against humanity, including torture and rape, in the West Bank.

articles.title: UN-commissioned experts say Gaza ceasefire has not stopped Israel from committing genocide
articles.description: A U.N.-commissioned group of independent experts accuses Israel of committing genocide in Gaza despite a ceasefire agreement. The report, released Monday, also claims Israeli forces committed crimes against humanity, including torture and rape, in the West Bank. Israel denies these allegations and has not responded to the report. The Associated Press could not independently verify the graphic accounts detailed in it. The findings by the Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory aim to document allegations and evidence to support accountability. The report claims Israeli actions have resulted in significant harm and expansion into Gaza.
